sentences.jp: それは、まるで一族の綱領を読み上げるかのような、静かで揺るがぬ声だった。

sentences.jp: 彼女は心の内で、シャケの郷土への濫伐——三年前、自分が立ち上がる前に砕いておくべきだった驕慢——を思い起こしていた。

sentences.en: She was recalling, in her heart, the reckless deforestation of the salmon's homeland—an arrogance that should have been shattered before she stood up three years ago.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.jp: 「認めよう。北京の女帝は郷土を滅ぼし、三種十六軍を統一した。さらに三年前のルシングの戦いにおいて、双国の三大武人をも斬り殺した。まさに、不滅の功績と言えるだろう」。
sentences.ruby: 「認[みと]めよう。北京[ぺきん]の女帝[じょてい]は郷土[きょうど]を滅[ほろ]ぼし、三種十六軍[さんしゅじゅうろくぐん]を統一[とういつ]した。さらに三年前[さんねんまえ]のルシングの戦[たたか]いにおいて、双国[そうこく]の三大武人[さんだいぶじん]をも斬[き]り殺[ころ]した。まさに、不滅[ふめつ]の功績[こうせき]と言えるだろう」。
sentences.en: "I must acknowledge that the Empress of Beijing has destroyed her homeland and unified the Three Types and Sixteen Armies. Furthermore, in the Battle of Lusheng three years ago, she also killed the three great warriors of the dual nations. Truly, it can be said to be an immortal achievement."

sentences.jp: 彼はチェンブーファンを睨み据えた。

sentences.en: "Let me give you one piece of advice: there are some opponents you cannot afford to confront."

sentences.en: "Faced with the Empress's intentions, I sensed it, but I am not particularly afraid."

sentences.jp: 普段から己の体には人一倍気をつけている男だ、ここで取り乱す姿は見せられぬ——そう自分に言い聞かせているのが、イエリンには手に取るように分かった。

sentences.en: He is a man who usually takes extra care of his body, and he tells himself that he cannot show any signs of losing composure here—Yelin could easily see that.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ruby: 彼[かれ]は冷[ひ]ややかに笑[わら]った。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.en: "However, no matter how much power the Empress of Beijing possesses, she cannot interfere with the salmon. And this engagement cannot be dissolved."

sentences.ruby: 「言わせてもらうが——この婚約[こんやく]は、解消[かいしょう]できる」。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.en: "Hey, you, enough already! It was just luck that She-sama protected us in the mythic realm. Compared to the president's army, you're nothing but a bug!"

sentences.en: Everyone is watching each other's expressions, desperately trying to align their perceptions—whether Yelin is truly alive or not.
